reference_and_denominators.reference: Original receiver on clean Native-LoS from same locked pose or G4 condition; evaluator only
reference_and_denominators.reference_valid: Finite clean native CIR, positive peak above numeric floor, finite selected s/range and positive two-port denominator; one polarization null allowed. This is exact-clean arithmetic support, not physical device sensitivity.
reference_and_denominators.raw_valid: The same validity definition on the current waveform; original zero-CIR detected=True does not override invalid s/denominator.
reference_and_denominators.unknown_reference: not reference_valid; preserve in all-input and output-availability denominators
reference_and_denominators.original_invalid: reference_valid AND not raw_valid; report separately, do not turn an arbitrary invalid raw tap into a wrong-reference detection label
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_all_pool: nL appears in distinct tap IDs including raw fallback
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_supported_pool: nL has at least one actual supporting lobe record, not only the fallback role
reference_and_denominators.reference_in_usable_pool: reference_in_supported_pool AND no overflow AND raw_valid; this is the primary candidate-availability success event for large errors
reference_and_denominators.normal_preservation: For valid original frames, n0 is retained in the candidate pool exactly. For invalid frames, preserve only raw metadata and require no candidates. No replacement is performed, so this is a construction check rather than selective-correction false-positive performance.

cluster_accounting.dynamic_error_episode: Within each route and waveform, maximal consecutive large-error rows; break when the label is not large, original pose_id is not prior+1, or elapsed timestamp exceeds 0.4s. Episode IDs are evaluator-only.
cluster_accounting.static_cluster: Coordinate ID; report four yaws together and all raw conditions individually
cluster_accounting.inference: Descriptive packet/episode/coordinate counts only. No IID packet CI, population safety probability or claim of independent RF environments.

observed_gate.primary: Dynamic Full TWO_PORT_UNION usable candidate recall among >=2tap errors >=0.95, with all route denominators disclosed.
observed_gate.stratified_guard: Every route with a nonzero large-error denominator must also meet >=0.95; otherwise report NOT_SUPPORTED_STRATIFIED and keep E2 GO false. A zero denominator is NOT_TESTED for that route, never 100% recall.
observed_gate.statistical_status: Even a numeric pass is DESCRIPTIVE_CANDIDATE_AVAILABILITY only; reviewer must assess episode support. No automatic H2 selection success or E2 authorization.
